sbar.situation: The bank system has recovered after four faults; the last recovery check at 41 s was clean, with 2 clean looks in a row. Ledger data still holds duplicate payments that need the operations team.
sbar.background: Payments was deployed from 1.3 to 1.5 (skipping 1.4) about 14 s before diagnosis, and the ledger data check then failed with duplicate payments. At the same time the screening primary slowed to p95 1820 ms (baseline 15 ms), clearing crashed on item 95, and a reconciliation session held a write lock on the ledger.
sbar.assessment: Screening calls timed out against the payments 1.0 s limit, so the incident commander failed screening over to its standby, which now serves it. It also ended the reconciliation session holding the ledger lock and rolled payments back from 1.5 to 1.3. It quarantined clearing item 95, which caused a JSONDecodeError, and restarted clearing; all of these actions completed.
sbar.recommendation: The operations team must find and correct the duplicate payment records in the ledger; the latest data check shows 21, up from 16. They must also review clearing item 95 and either repair and resubmit it or close it with its customer. Check the screening primary and the payments 1.5 release before moving back to either.
